evidence: Their composition was analyzed by x-ray diffraction and Rutherford backscattering spectroscopy. The measurement setup is equipped with a Yokogawa 7651 current source and a Keithley 2700 multimeter/data acquisition system. Additional measurements were made by Rutherford backscattering spectroscopy (RBS) with 1.4 MeV accelerated 4He+-ions to analyze the film composition of our atomic layer deposited NbN thin films. Ellipsometry measurements show an additional aluminum oxide layer on the sample of about 0.7 nm after TMAl exposure. Atomic force microscopy on the sample with the highest TC showed a root-mean-square roughness of only 1 nm for a scanning field of 4.5× 4.5 µm2 and 40 nm thick films.
